npcs.name: Asvor Eyvindsmother
npcs.idle: My son swore an oath to wolves. Now the wolves hunt him for breaking it.

npcs.name: Halvdan the Scout
npcs.idle: The blood-fellowship? Raiders with a creed. Worse than raiders without one.

npcs.name: Gothi Valbrand
npcs.idle: The gods are listening. Speak carefully.

npcs.name: Huscarl Grettir
npcs.idle: Kolbein was my shield-mate. We don't leave shield-mates.

npcs.name: Shield-Captain Sigvaldi
npcs.idle: The Shieldwall holds Huginfel. Lately it holds it facing west.

npcs.name: Ragnfrid Wolf-Widow
npcs.idle: The last farm before the Blodfelag's country. My husband said we'd never leave it. He was right, in his way.

quests.title: The Oathbreaker
quests.offer:
My son Eyvind swore the oath of the blood-fellowship last spring - the blodfelag, raiders who drink each other's blood to bind them. He was sixteen and stupid.

This winter he tried to leave them. They call deserters 'oathbreakers' and hunt them like wolves. Halvdan the [scout] says they're close. Will you [find Eyvind] before they do?

topics.scout: Halvdan. By the gate. He's been watching the ridge for days.

quests.summary: Asvor's son swore an oath to the blood-fellowship raiders, then deserted. Now they hunt him.

steps.goal: Ask Halvdan the scout about the hunt
steps.say: The blodfelag have henchmen out on the eastern ridge - deserter-hunters. The deserters, the [oathbreakers], hide in the woods south of here. Kill the hunters first, or they'll follow you straight to him.

steps.goal: Kill the blood-fellowship henchmen hunting deserters
steps.text: One of them carries a list of names. Eyvind's is third. The first two are crossed out.

steps.goal: Search the deserters' hideout in the southern woods
steps.text: An oath-ring, cut through. Fresh blood on the ground - not much. A voice from the bracken: 'Mother? ...No. Who are you?'

steps.say:
She sent you. Course she did.

I drank the blood. I swore. And then they burned a farm with the children in it and I couldn't - I couldn't. Now I'm an oathbreaker. That's worse than a murderer, to them. They're [coming].

steps.text: The last of the fellowship's hunters lies in the bracken. Eyvind is shaking, but alive.

stages.name: Keep Eyvind alive
stages.announce: Horns in the woods. The blodfelag are here. 'OATHBREAKER!'
stages.thanks: He was my oath-brother. He taught me to hold an axe.

stages.name: Hrolf Blood-Axe
stages.announce: A svard with a blood-red axe strides out. 'You drank my blood, boy. I've come to take it back.'

steps.say:
There are others like me in these woods. Boys who ran. If I go [home], the fellowship will come to Huginfel for me one day. If I stay and lead the [other deserters] north, maybe we can live.

Mother would want me home. I know that. What do you think?

options.say: Home. All right. I'll hang up the axe. And if they come, they come.
Then tell her I'm sorry. Tell her I'm doing something right, for once. Tell her I'll write - I can't write. Tell her I'll learn.

steps.say:
He's home. He sleeps with the axe under his bed, and he wakes up shouting, and he's HOME.

Whatever comes for him, it'll have to come through me. Here - take this. You brought my boy back.

Leading the other boys north. My Eyvind. Who couldn't lead a goat to grass.

I'm proud of him. Gods help me, I'm proud of him. Take this. It was meant to be his.

north.text: It was meant to be his.

quests.title: The Wolf-Cord
quests.offer:
A huscarl of this keep, Kolbein, vanished on patrol in the west a month ago. Last week a shepherd saw him - running with the sveawolves, on all fours, howling.

The blood-fellowship's witches, the haxa, bind men to wolf-spirits to make their wolf-warriors. Huscarl [Grettir] was his shield-mate and won't rest. Will you [find Kolbein]? Bring him back a man, if the gods allow it.

topics.Grettir: By the gate. He's been standing there a month, as if Kolbein might walk back in.

quests.summary: A huscarl vanished on patrol and was seen running on all fours with the wolves. The blood-fellowship's witches bind men to wolf-spirits.

steps.goal: Ask Huscarl Grettir about the patrol
steps.say: We camped by the north bridge. In the night something sang in the woods - a woman's voice. Kolbein got up and walked toward it, and I couldn't wake. I couldn't WAKE. In the morning there were wolf tracks over his [bedroll].

steps.goal: Go to the patrol's last camp by the north bridge
steps.text: The bedroll's still here, clawed to ribbons. Wolf tracks lead south.
One of them wears a huscarl's arm-ring on its foreleg - Kolbein's. But it isn't Kolbein. It's just a wolf. He's somewhere else.

steps.goal: Search the old longhouse west of the keep
steps.text: A cord of plaited hair, wound round a wolf's skull, and the runes for Kolbein's name. A spare. The one that holds him is with the haxa who made it.

steps.goal: Kill the haxa who bound Kolbein
steps.text: The haxa falls. Her wolf-warriors drop their weapons, whimpering. One of them - grey, gaunt, wearing a huscarl's ragged tabard - doesn't run.

stages.name: Haxa Grimhild
stages.announce: A woman in wolf-skins looks up from her fire and laughs. 'You want the huscarl? He's mine. He likes it.'

steps.say:
...Grettir? No. No, you smell different.

I remember. I remember the keep, and the mead, and Grettir's terrible singing. I remember it like a story about someone else. The [cord] - she's dead, but it still holds. I can feel it in my chest.

steps.goal: Decide what to do with the wolf-cord
steps.say:
If you [cut the cord], I'm a man again. The wolf goes out of me and something else goes with it - I don't know what. I'll never run like this again. Never smell the rain coming three valleys off.

Or you [let me run]. Tell Grettir I died well. He'd believe that.

options.say: Do it. Do it quick. ... Oh. Oh, gods, I'm cold. Is it always this cold?
Thank you. Tell the gothi I'm not sorry. Tell Grettir I'll howl for him on the long nights.

steps.say:
Kolbein walked through the gate on two feet this morning. Grettir wept like a child.

He keeps going to the window at night. Standing there, listening. I think he'll do that the rest of his life. But he's ours. The gods were kind, and so were you.

He chose the wolves.

Grettir hasn't spoken since you told him. Last night we heard howling from the west, long and low, and Grettir went up on the wall and howled back. I said nothing. Take this.

quests.title: Mindless
quests.offer:
The Blodfelag take thralls from the farms - and something takes their minds. They wander the road east of here, empty, and attack anything that moves.

They were our neighbours. Will you [give them rest]?
quests.summary: The Blodfelag's mindless thralls wander West Svealand's eastern road, attacking anything that moves.

steps.goal: Give the mindless thralls rest about 460 m north of Shield-Captain Sigvaldi

steps.say: Rest. That's what we can give them now. I hate it.

quests.title: The Oathbreakers
quests.offer:
The Blodfelag oathbreakers - men who broke their oaths to their jarls and swore new ones in blood - camp west of town and raid the thrall road.

Will you [break their camp]?
quests.summary: Blodfelag oathbreakers camp west of Huginfel and raid the thrall road.

steps.goal: Break the oathbreakers' camp about 250 m north-west of Shield-Captain Sigvaldi

steps.say: Broken. They'll go west, to their own country. Everything goes west now.

quests.title: The Blood-Oath
quests.offer:
The henchmen carry the Blodfelag's oaths written out - who swore, and to what. Bring me one. I want to know what my neighbours were sold to.

Will you [take an oath-scroll]?
quests.summary: Blodfelag henchmen carry written blood-oaths along West Svealand's thrall road.

steps.goal: Kill the blodfelag henchmen about 230 m north of Shield-Captain Sigvaldi
Search the oathbreakers' camp for an oath-scroll

clue.name: a scroll in a wolf-skin case

steps.text: The oath, in blood: 'I give my blood to the Wolf's children. When the long winter comes, I will run with them. When the Wolf breaks his chain, I will hold the door open.'

steps.say:
'When the Wolf breaks his chain.' Fenrir. They're swearing to Fenrir's children - to the end of the world.

Huscarl Grettir at Vindsaul Faste needs to see this. And the gothi.

quests.title: An Ill Wind
quests.offer:
The wind sprites of the middle wood have always been playful - a hat blown off, a fire blown out. Now they blow cold. Ice on the barley in summer.

Will you [calm them]?
quests.summary: The wind sprites of West Svealand's middle wood have begun blowing cold in summer.

steps.goal: Calm the wind sprites about 710 m south-west of Gothi Valbrand

steps.say: Calmer. But they're not making the cold, only carrying it. It comes from the west.

quests.title: The She-Wolves
quests.offer:
Bloodthirsty she-wolves in the middle wood, killing for the pleasure of it. Wolves don't do that. Not ordinary wolves.

Will you [hunt them]?
quests.summary: Bloodthirsty she-wolves kill for pleasure in West Svealand's middle wood.

steps.goal: Hunt the bloodthirsty she-wolves about 600 m south-west of Huscarl Grettir

steps.say: Not ordinary wolves. The Blodfelag feed them. On what, I don't want to know.

quests.title: The Wood-Wives
quests.offer:
The skogsfru - the wood-wives, lovely from the front and hollow as a dead tree behind - have left their groves and come out onto the roads. They lure travellers in and nobody comes out.

They're fleeing something too. Will you [drive them back]?
quests.summary: The skogsfru, the hollow-backed wood-wives, have come out of their groves onto West Svealand's roads.

steps.goal: Drive the skogsfru back into their grove about 620 m south-west of Gothi Valbrand

steps.say: One of them spoke as she died. 'The winter comes through the trees.' Even the wood-wives are afraid.

quests.title: The Frozen Gully
quests.offer:
There's a gully in the south-west where my husband watered the sheep. It froze over in midsummer, and it hasn't thawed. He went to look. He didn't come back.

Will you [go and look]? Carefully.
quests.summary: A gully in West Svealand's south-west froze over in midsummer and hasn't thawed.

steps.goal: Go to the frozen gully in the south-west
steps.text: Snow on the ground in summer. Your breath smokes. The light down in the gully moves like something alive.

clue.name: a shepherd's crook, frozen into the ice

steps.text: Ragnfrid's husband's crook, and under the clear ice, his face - peaceful, as if asleep. The ice isn't water. It's colder than water can be.

steps.say:
So that's where he is. Thank you. I'd rather know.

It's spreading. Every week it's a little further up the hill. Something in there is making winter.

quests.title: Cold Lights
quests.offer:
The lights in the gully - cold lights, the old folk called them - lead men down onto the ice. Like they led him.

Will you [put them out]?
quests.summary: Cold lights lead men down onto the never-thawing ice of the frozen gully.

steps.goal: Put out the cold lights about 820 m south of Ragnfrid Wolf-Widow

steps.say: Out. For now. There are other things down there - small white things, and a colt made of frost.

quests.title: The Things in the Snow
quests.offer:
Snow imps and frost colts. Things out of the far north - out of Raumarik, where my grandmother said the winter never ends. They're here. In summer.

It's a job for a few. Will you [clear the gully]?
quests.summary: Snow imps and frost colts out of the far north have made the frozen gully their den.

steps.goal: Clear the snow imps from the gully about 810 m south of Ragnfrid Wolf-Widow
Bring down the frosty colts about 840 m south of Ragnfrid Wolf-Widow

steps.say: Raumarik things, in my husband's gully. The Blodfelag's windcallers pray to the north every night. I think it listens.

quests.title: The Warhounds
quests.offer:
The Blodfelag's warhounds come round my farm every night now, testing the fence. One night the fence won't hold.

Will you [kill the hounds]?
quests.summary: The Blodfelag's warhounds test the fences of the last farm before their country.

steps.goal: Kill the blodfelag warhounds about 430 m south-east of Ragnfrid Wolf-Widow

steps.say: Quiet nights, for a while. Thank you.

quests.title: The Windcallers
quests.offer:
The Blodfelag's windcallers stand on the hills by their hall and sing to the north wind. And it comes. Snow in the barley, ice on the wells.

Will you [silence them]?
quests.summary: The Blodfelag's windcallers sing the north wind down onto West Svealand's summer fields.

steps.goal: Silence the blodfelag windcallers about 1.1 km south-west of Huscarl Grettir

steps.say: Silenced. And the wind dropped as they fell - Valbrand felt it from here.

quests.title: Wolf-Warriors
quests.offer:
The wolfwarriors - Blodfelag berserkers who wear the wolf - camp in the north-west, by the haxa's circle. They're the ones who'll lead when the Blodfelag march.

Bring friends. Will you [break the wolfwarriors]?
quests.summary: Blodfelag wolfwarriors, berserkers who wear the wolf, camp in West Svealand's north-west.

steps.goal: Break the blodfelag wolfwarriors about 860 m west of Huscarl Grettir

steps.say: Good. Now the haxa - the blood-witches who read for them. That's where their orders come from.

quests.title: The Haxa
quests.offer:
The haxa - the Blodfelag's blood-witches - keep a circle in the north-west. They read the future in bowls of blood, and the Blodfelag do what they say.

Bring friends. Will you [break the circle]? And bring me what they read.
quests.summary: The Blodfelag's haxa read the future in bowls of blood in a circle in West Svealand's north-west.

steps.goal: Break the blodfelag haxa about 940 m west of Gothi Valbrand

clue.name: a bowl of blood, frozen solid

steps.text: The blood in the bowl froze in a pattern - a wolf's head, jaws open over a moon. Scratched into the bowl's rim: 'RAUMARIK. THE HOST GATHERS. HATI HUNTS THE MOON.'

steps.say:
Hati. The wolf that hunts the moon - Fenrir's own son. When he catches it, the long winter begins.

And his host gathers in Raumarik. The Blodfelag are only the first of them. Go and see Sigvaldi; the Shieldwall means to take the Blood-Hall.

quests.title: The Blood-Hall
quests.offer:
The Blodfelag's Blood-Hall, in the west. Every thrall they've taken went through its doors. The Shieldwall means to take it.

Go and [scout the hall]. Count them. Then come back and tell me we can win.
quests.summary: The Huginfel Shieldwall means to take the Blodfelag's Blood-Hall in West Svealand's west.

steps.goal: Climb the ridge above the Blood-Hall
steps.text: A long hall roofed with turf, a wolf's skull over the door, and snow on the roof in summer. The windcallers' song comes up from inside.
Thralls' chains, dozens of them, and fresh blood frozen on the post. Warhounds in the yard, and a warden in black mail at the door.

steps.say:
Dozens. Then we take it back for every one of them.

The Shieldwall will march when the farms are behind us - every Blodfelag broken, every thrall freed, tells the men they can win. Be there.

quests.title: The Southern Road
quests.offer:
Svartalf hunters on the southern road. They used to trade - furs for iron, honest enough. Now they hunt travellers and say the dragon will pay them in gold.

Will you [clear the road]?
quests.summary: Svartalf hunters on West Svealand's southern road hunt travellers for the dragon's gold.

steps.goal: Clear the svartalf hunters about 290 m west of Eyvind Asvorsson

steps.say: 'The dragon will pay.' Which dragon? Midgard's only got one that wants paying.

quests.title: The Chanters
quests.offer:
The svartalf chanters camp on the southern road and sing the hunters on. Break them, and see what they're carrying.

Will you [break the camp]?
quests.summary: Svartalf chanters camp on West Svealand's southern road and sing their hunters on.

steps.goal: Break the svartalf chanters about 160 m west of Eyvind Asvorsson

clue.name: a leather case under a bedroll

steps.text: A drakulv pass, stamped with a dragon's eye, good for 'the svartalf traders of Gotar and all who carry the Mother's word'.

steps.say: Gotar. The svartalf trading post in Gotar - that's where the dragon's road runs north from.
